name: MonarchDurationInput
title: DurationInput
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField (through MonarchTextField) with autocorrection off, androidx.compose.material3.IconButton for the stepper, and android.icu.text.MeasureFormat for the spoken duration
summary: A labelled field for a length of time typed as free text ("1h 30m", "90", "1.5h", "1:30"), saved as whole minutes, with − and + buttons that step on a grid.
whenToUse: For an estimate, a time limit, a break or a buffer that people think of as hours and minutes and like to type quickly.
whenNotToUse: For a time of day use the Material 3 TimePicker. For a plain count of units use MonarchNumberInput. For a date range use the Material 3 DateRangePicker.
api: @Composable fun MonarchDurationInput(minutes: Int?, onMinutesChange: (Int?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, label: String? = null, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, minimum: Int = 0, maximum: Int? = null, step: Int = 15, largestUnit: MonarchDurationInputUnit = MonarchDurationInputUnit.Hours, minutesPerDay: Int = 1440, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, showSteppers: Boolean = true, format: ((Int) -> String)? = null, parse: ((String) -> Int?)? = null, labels: MonarchDurationInputLabels = MonarchDurationInputLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

class MonarchDurationInputLabels(invalid: String? = null, range: ((minimum: Int, maximum: Int?) -> String)? = null, valueText: ((minutes: Int) -> String)? = null, increment: String? = null, decrement: String? = null)

options.name: minutes
options.description: The duration in whole minutes, or null while the field is empty.

options.name: onMinutesChange
options.description: Called with the new duration, or null when cleared, when the text is read (Done, leaving the field, before a step) or a step is taken; never on every keystroke.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Replaces the built-in placeholder "e.g. 1h 30m", shown while the field is empty and focused.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error from the app; replaces the field's own messages while present.

options.name: minimum
options.description: The shortest allowed duration in minutes. Shorter text is flagged; steps stop at it.

options.name: maximum
options.description: The longest allowed duration in minutes. Longer text is flagged; steps stop at it.

options.name: step
options.description: Minutes one press of − or +, an arrow key or a TalkBack action adds or removes, on a grid from zero.

options.name: minutesPerDay
options.description: The minutes in a "d" when reading and writing; 480 for eight-hour work days.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the field and the buttons can be used.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Selectable but not editable; the buttons are disabled.

options.name: showSteppers
options.description: Shows the − and + buttons and the Increase and Decrease actions.

options.name: format
options.description: Writes minutes as text. The default writes "0m", "45m", "1h 30m".

options.name: parse
options.description: Reads trimmed, non-empty text as minutes, or returns null when it cannot. Empty text always clears the value.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the invalid and range messages, the spoken duration and the button names.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the focus and press interactions of the field.

states.name: empty
states.description: The value is null; the placeholder shows while focused. The first step starts from the minimum.

states.name: value
states.description: The text is the duration written as "1h 30m"; TalkBack reads it in words as the field's state.

states.name: unreadable
states.description: A danger outline and "Use a duration like 1h 30m, 90m or 1.5h." under the field. The text is kept and the value is not changed.

states.name: out of range
states.description: A danger outline and "Enter between 15m and 2h.", "Enter at least 15m." or "Enter at most 2h.". The text is kept and the value is not changed.

states.name: error
states.description: The app's message in place of the field's own, drawn the same way.

states.name: at a bound
states.description: The button that would pass the bound is disabled and its action is removed.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The subtle background and the disabled text color; both buttons are disabled.

states.name: read only
states.description: The text can be selected but not changed; both buttons are disabled.

appearance: The field is MonarchTextField: a surface fill with the input border, the focus ring color when focused and the danger strong color in error. The − and + signs use the default text color, or the disabled text color when their button is disabled. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Matches the web's DurationInput and iOS: the same forms are read (90, 90m, 1h 30m, 1h30, 1.5h, 1,5h, 1:30, 2 hours 15 minutes, 1d 4h), the same "1h 30m" format is written, the value is whole minutes and unreadable text is kept and flagged, never saved. The web's sm, md and lg sizes are not offered; the field is the size of MonarchTextField. The web steps with ArrowUp and ArrowDown and moves an hour with PageUp and PageDown; Android does the same with a hardware keyboard, and adds − and + icon buttons (on by default, as on iOS) and Increase and Decrease TalkBack actions. Home, End and Escape are not handled. With a minimum of 0 and a maximum, the range message is "Enter at most 2h." where the web says "Enter between 0m and 2h.", as on iOS. Unit words are read in English, as on the web; the spoken duration uses android.icu.text.MeasureFormat in the person's language. iOS has an errorHint label for its "Error: …" hint; Android has no such string because TalkBack announces the field's error semantics itself. The keyboard is the text keyboard with autocorrection off, since unit letters must be typed.
accessibility: The field is the Material 3 text field: TalkBack reads the label, the text, the error and, as the state, the duration in words ("1 hour, 30 minutes").
A new message for unreadable or out-of-range text is the field's error, shown with text and a danger outline, not color alone.
The − and + buttons are Material 3 icon buttons named "Decrease" and "Increase", each with a 48dp touch target; the sign itself is hidden from TalkBack.
The field has Increase and Decrease custom actions while a step is possible.
The decrease button is at the start and the increase button at the end, mirrored in right-to-left layouts.
With a hardware keyboard the up and down arrows step and Page Up and Page Down move an hour.
Autocorrection is off so unit letters are not replaced.
edgeCases: Changing minutes from outside replaces the text on screen and clears the field's own message.
Fractions of a minute are rounded to the nearest minute: "0.5" is 1 minute.
"1:75" is not a clock and is flagged; "30m 5" is flagged, while "1h30" is 90 minutes.
A step from text that cannot be read starts from the saved value, else from the minimum.
A maximum below the minimum counts as the minimum.
A step of zero or less steps by one minute.

examples.title: Estimate
examples.template:
MonarchDurationInput(
    minutes = estimate,
    onMinutesChange = { estimate = it },
    label = {{label}},
    helperText = {{helper}},
    showSteppers = false,
)
examples.code:
MonarchDurationInput(
    minutes = estimate,
    onMinutesChange = { estimate = it },
    label = "Estimate",
    helperText = "Type 1h 30m, 90m or 1.5h. Arrow keys step by 15 minutes.",
    showSteppers = false,
)

examples.title: Days of eight hours
examples.code:
MonarchDurationInput(
    minutes = leave,
    onMinutesChange = { leave = it },
    label = "Time off",
    largestUnit = MonarchDurationInputUnit.Days,
    minutesPerDay = 480,
    step = 480,
)
